title: Templates list, per-axle starters, the Axles control and required fields
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in with 'Settings - Service' enabled, on the build under test (template authoring).
  2. The templates list showing the five seeded starter templates; and a per-axle field's properties panel.
custom_steps:
1. Confirm the templates list describes usage as 'times used' (not 'runs') on both the summary figure and the table column.
2. Confirm starters use one per-axle field where the same thing is measured on every position (Light-Duty PM's tread + pressure; Air-Brake's push-rod + lining; Class 8 Tractor PM's four brake-lining checks; Trailer's lining + tread), while the DOT form keeps its own structure.
3. Confirm the per-axle Axles control sits in the panel shaped like a measurement row, below the rows and above the add control, headed 'Measurement rows · every axle', defaulting to 3, offering 1 to 8, explained on demand; an out-of-range count drops back to the default rather than being rejected.
4. Confirm seeded templates arrive with checkbox fields required to complete and text/notes/measurement fields optional.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The templates list describes usage as "times used", not "runs", on both the summary figure and the table column.
  • Where the same thing is measured or judged on every wheel position, a starter uses one per-axle field rather than one field per position; the DOT form keeps its own structure.
  • Seeded templates arrive with checkbox fields marked required to complete and text, notes and measurement fields optional.
  • A per-axle field's properties panel offers an Axles control shaped like a measurement row, below the rows and above the add control, defaulting to 3 and offering 1 to 8, explained on demand; the rows above it are headed "Measurement rows · every axle".
  • An axle count outside the offered range is dropped back to the default rather than rejected.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-8181, story SV-9110 (S12 — Template builder authoring); Digital Inspections V2 specification, Confluence page 768507905, section S12; read on 22 September 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S12-R26: “The templates list will describe usage as times used, not as runs, on the summary figure and the table column alike”
  • S12-R27: “Where the same thing is measured or judged on every wheel position, a starter will use one per-axle field rather than one field per position. The seed templates were authored before the per-axle field existed, which is why they carry positional fields the new type replaces. Light-Duty PM's four tread measurements and its tire pressure become one per-axle field; Air-Brake's push-rod travel and lining thickness become one; Class 8 Tractor PM's four per-axle brake-lining checks become one; Trailer's lining thickness and tread depth become one. The DOT form keeps its own structure — an inspector signs against its stated items”
  • S12-R28: “Seeded templates will arrive with checkbox fields marked required to complete, and with text, notes and measurement fields optional. A shop turns off what it does not want rather than turning on what it does. Requiring every field would put a required comment in every section of the largest starter and would fight the one-press Mark OK of S18”
  • S12-R29: “A per-axle field will offer an Axles control in its properties panel, in the shape of a measurement row and sitting below the rows, above the control that adds one — so the panel reads top to bottom: what every axle is measured on, then how many axles to start with. It defaults to 3 and offers 1 to 8, and it is explained on demand rather than in permanent text. The rows above it are headed "Measurement rows · every axle"”
  • S12-R30: “An axle count outside the offered range is dropped back to the default rather than rejected. A template that fails to save over a starting point would be worse than one that starts at three”

Amended on 13 October 2026
S12-R29 changed on 29 September 2026 (Digital Inspections V2 specification, Confluence page 768507905, read on 13 October 2026): the Axles control offers 1 to 8 (was 2 to 5). S12-R28 now says "the largest starter" instead of "a 77-field template". The quotes above are the current wording; step 3 and the expected results follow it.

Last checked against build v26.36.8-2a64085 on 10/1/2026.
